title: SAVOY pizza — Tokyo branches
brief: Every current SAVOY branch in Tokyo, so you can pick one. Public information only; checked against the official site, Tabelog, AutoReserve and Hot Pepper.
notes: All three Azabu-Juban shops (Main Store, Tomato & Cheese, Hanare) close on Wednesdays; the Main Store has no lunch on Thursdays. Mishuku-dori closes Wednesdays and Thursdays; Giardino closes Mondays. Left out: SAVOY Spa Japo, inside a spa complex in Higashi-Kurume (far north-west suburbs), because I couldn't confirm it still trades.

places.name: SAVOY Azabu-Juban Main Store
places.address_ja: 東京都港区麻布十番2-20-12 オリエント麻布1F
places.summary: SAVOY's flagship — the original 1995 Moto-Azabu pizzeria, relocated here in 2023 — with wood-fired pizza at counters facing the ovens.
places.order: The original SAVOY pizzas: Margherita and Marinara (from the classic counter). Seasonal creative pizzas too.

practical.price: Tabelog: lunch ¥1,000–1,999, dinner ¥2,000–2,999. AutoReserve average: lunch ¥3,500, dinner ¥5,000

research.notes: Reopened here on 25 Mar 2023 after the Moto-Azabu shop closed for rebuilding. Opened as three counters under one roof: 'savoy Classic' (original menu), 'Domi-LA!' (new-style pizzas) and WOODSTOCK TOKYO (now listed as closed). AutoReserve showed lunch seatings at 11:30 and 13:00, dinner at 17:30, 19:00 and 20:30.
open_questions: Do 'savoy Classic' and 'Domi-LA' still run as separate counters? The official site now shows one main store.
Last-order times and payment methods not found.
The Azabu-Juban shopping-street directory seemed to give a different closed day; the official site and Tabelog both say Wednesday.

places.name: SAVOY Tomato & Cheese
places.ja: SAVOY とまととちーず店
places.address_ja: 東京都港区麻布十番3-3-13 M2Kステージ 1F
places.summary: Ten-seat counter pizzeria built around the wood-fired oven; the Margherita is the signature.
places.order: Margherita — the shop's signature (fresh tomato and mozzarella on long-fermented dough).

practical.price: Tabelog dinner ¥4,000–4,999. AutoReserve average about ¥4,000–4,500 lunch, ¥5,000–6,500 dinner
practical.queue: Reviews describe lunch queues: about 10 groups at the 11:30 opening on one visit, full within ten minutes on another

research.notes: Open since April 2013. SAVOY Azabu-Juban Hanare is in the basement of the same building.
open_questions: Lunch end: official site 15:00 (last order 14:30); Tabelog 14:30.
Queue reports are from reviews of unknown date.

places.address_ja: 東京都港区麻布十番3-3-13 M2Kステージ B1F

places.name: SAVOY Kaminarimon
places.address_ja: 東京都台東区浅草1-2-8 MISTY共同ビル 1F
places.station: Asakusa, 1–5 min walk; steps from the Kaminarimon gate
places.summary: SAVOY's Asakusa branch (opened August 2023): a small counter pizza bar by Kaminarimon, with a shorter pizza menu than the other branches.
places.order: Margherita or Marinara. A red-bean (anko) dessert pizza is reported as a Kaminarimon-only item.

practical.price: Tabelog: lunch ¥1,000–1,999, dinner ¥2,000–2,999 (another write-up: about ¥2,500 lunch, ¥4,000 dinner)
practical.reservation: Accepted — phone or online (AutoReserve); seating time about 90 min
practical.seats: Ground-floor counter; basement private room for 6–12

research.notes: Tabelog reviewers note a narrower pizza line-up than at other SAVOY shops.

places.name: SAVOY Mishuku-dori
places.address_ja: 東京都世田谷区下馬1-23-13 フェルテロアール祐天寺 1F
places.summary: Neighbourhood SAVOY on Mishuku-dori, with tables and a terrace, serving pizza and pasta.

practical.payment: Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Diners, JCB) per Hot Pepper
practical.reservation: Accepted — phone, AutoReserve, or Tabelog's line 050-5868-5265

research.notes: Reopened after a renovation on 1 Nov 2025 with more seats; weekday lunch (pizza and sandwiches) from Feb 2026. Tabelog Pizza Hyakumeiten 2019. Terrace seats allow pets.
open_questions: Seat count after the renovation (listings say 26, 38 or 41).
Opening days: an older listing showed weekends only; current listings show five days.
